title: The Book Thief
author: Markus Zusak
summary: Narrated by Death, this novel follows Liesel, a girl placed with foster parents in Nazi Germany, who steals books and learns to read as her family hides a Jewish man in the basement.
readIf: you want a moving, unusual Second World War story built around the love of books.
skipIf: you can't take a narrator who foreshadows deaths, or a sad ending.

pairings.reason: Another war story about a child's life in occupied Europe, written in short, lyrical chapters.
A shorter, simpler story of children in wartime Germany, with a harsher ending.
Another emotional Second World War novel, centred on sisters in France.
